articles.title: Could a Storm Rage Forever? The Shocking Truth from Zelda and Real Life
articles.summary: In Zelda games, storms never stop until Link solves a quest. But real storms can't last forever. A place in Venezuela called Catatumbo comes close, with lightning up to 300 days a year!

articles.title: T. rex Took 40 Years to Grow Up—Way Longer Than We Thought!
articles.summary: Scientists used to think T. rex grew up by age 25. But a new study of 17 fossils shows it took about 40 years to reach its full size of eight tons. That's like waiting until you're a grandparent to be fully grown!

articles.title: Fold a Paper Circuit! Origami Meets Electronics in a Cool New Way
articles.summary: Scientists made a special paper that conducts electricity when you fold or cut it. You can add lights and motors to your origami creations. It costs about $1.80 for a 10-centimeter square.
